title: GS21 leverage U (distress and credit rationing) with a continuous firm-level debt capacity: exposure +1.0 (b~^2 - 1), unbounded, per-firm level compensation (gs_qcomp 1), price 2.5; the mirror of the hump gvylqn10
question: Does the leverage hump clear the bar once the exposure is not switched off by the cap?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-06). gvylqn10 (the same exposure with loading -1.0, a hump) has a fair gap of +0.125 (t 8.8, 10/10). This flips the sign: highly levered firms (distress) and lowly levered firms (credit rationed) carry the most cash-flow exposure. The per-firm compensation W(e)^(-1) equalises the priced value of the exposure across firms, so leverage is not revealed by value. gvylqun5 (+0.5) was null (+0.007, 5/10); the hump was also null at -0.5 (gvylqn5 +0.0015) and only woke at -1.0.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-06): if the hump's room comes from the curvature itself, the U has room 20% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029; if it comes from the hump's sign (middle leverage most exposed, extremes least), the U is null like gvylqun5. FALSIFIED (as a U) if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
